# Third-party notices

RA-enabled XM8 builds include the following source dependencies:

| Component | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| SDL2 | 2.32.10 | zlib |
| rcheevos | 12.3.0 | MIT |
| SQLite | 3.53.0 | Public Domain |
| stb_image | 2.30 | MIT OR Public Domain |

The distribution also contains xBRZ, whose source files identify GPLv3, while
the XM8 repository root contains the GPLv2 text. All corresponding license
texts are included in the `Licenses` directory of the RA-enabled application
bundle. See `ThirdParty/README.md` and `ThirdParty/versions.json` in the source
distribution for provenance and checksums.
